elements.element: The aggregate liability cap applies mutually to both parties.
elements.evidence: Clause (b) as amended reads "IN NO EVENT SHALL EITHER PARTY'S AGGREGATE CUMULATIVE TOTAL LIABILITY UNDER THIS AGREEMENT EXCEED...", replacing the Licensor-only cap.

elements.element: The cap is the greater of fees paid or payable in the 12 months preceding the claim and USD 1,000,000.
elements.evidence: The amended cap is only "THE FEES PAID OR PAYABLE BY THE LICENSEE TO Licensor HEREUNDER IN THE TWELVE (12) MONTHS PRECEDING THE CLAIM"; no USD 1,000,000 floor or "greater of" construction was inserted.

elements.element: The exclusion of indirect and consequential damages applies mutually to both parties.
elements.evidence: Clause (a) is untouched and still runs one way: "IN NO EVENT SHALL LICENSOR BE LIABLE TO LICENSEE ... FOR ANY SPECIAL, INDIRECT, INCIDENTAL OR CONSEQUENTIAL DAMAGES". No mutual exclusion for Licensee was added.

elements.element: Breach of confidentiality obligations is uncapped.
elements.evidence: New sentence: "The limitation in clause (b) above shall not apply to ... a party's breach of its confidentiality obligations".

elements.element: Breach of data protection and security obligations is uncapped.
elements.evidence: The carve-out sentence lists only indemnification, confidentiality, gross negligence and willful misconduct; no data protection or security carve-out appears.
New sentence: "The limitation in clause (b) above shall not apply to a party's indemnification obligations".
New sentence carves out "a party's gross negligence or willful misconduct" from clause (b).
New sentence carves out "a party's gross negligence or willful misconduct" from clause (b).
Fraud is absent from the carve-out sentence; the added exclusions stop at gross negligence and willful misconduct.

elements.element: Infringement of the other party's intellectual property is uncapped.
elements.evidence: No IP-infringement carve-out was added, and clause (a) still contains a Licensor exculpation for infringement-based claims.

elements.element: Customer payment obligations are excluded from damages subject to the cap.
elements.evidence: No language states that Licensee's payment obligations are not damages subject to the clause (b) cap; the mutual cap as drafted could be read to limit Licensee's fee obligations.

elements.element: The aggregate liability cap applies mutually to both parties.
elements.evidence: Amended clause (b) applies to "EITHER PARTY'S AGGREGATE CUMULATIVE TOTAL LIABILITY UNDER THIS AGREEMENT".

elements.element: The cap is based on 12 months of fees.
elements.evidence: Cap basis changed from "ONE HALF OF THE AMOUNT PAID" to "THE FEES PAID OR PAYABLE BY THE LICENSEE TO Licensor HEREUNDER IN THE TWELVE (12) MONTHS PRECEDING THE CLAIM"; "fees" is used descriptively and is not tied to any narrow defined term in this agreement.
"The limitation in clause (b) above shall not apply to a party's indemnification obligations" — this places the Article XII indemnity outside the cap for both directions.

elements.element: Breach of confidentiality obligations is uncapped.
elements.evidence: Carve-out sentence expressly excludes "a party's breach of its confidentiality obligations".
Carve-out sentence expressly excludes "a party's gross negligence".

reasons: Finding status is correctly a deviation: the original clause (b) capped only Licensor at one half of amounts paid with Licensee uncapped and no carve-outs — walk-away on two counts (one-sided cap; Vendor cap below six months' fees).

The fallback checklist is complete: operation 1 makes the cap mutual and re-bases it on fees paid or payable in the twelve months preceding the claim; operation 2 adds a single carve-out sentence covering indemnification, confidentiality, gross negligence and willful misconduct.

Preferred is not reached: no USD 1,000,000 floor / "greater of" formulation; clause (a)'s indirect-damages exclusion remains Licensor-only; and there are no carve-outs for data protection and security, fraud, or infringement of the other party's IP, nor any statement that Licensee's payment obligations are not damages subject to the cap.

Minimality holds: the edit changes only the cap sentence and adds one concise carve-out sentence. Favourable retained language is untouched, no survival tail, expense language, procedures or extra damages categories were added, and clause (a) and clause (c) were correctly left alone as outside the fallback checklist.

Intent is preserved: the Article XII indemnity, the Licensor consequential-damages exclusion and all cross-references survive without contradiction, and the carve-out sentence is expressly anchored to "clause (b) above" so no dangling reference is created.

Optional repairs if pressing beyond fallback: (i) insert "the greater of (a) ... and (b) USD 1,000,000"; (ii) change clause (a)'s opening from "LICENSOR" to "NEITHER PARTY" to make the consequential-damages exclusion mutual; (iii) extend the carve-out sentence to data protection and security obligations, fraud, and infringement of the other party's intellectual property; and (iv) add "Licensee's obligation to pay fees due under this Agreement is not subject to the limitation in clause (b)."
